answer: Require every agent identity to stake a bond and build a verifiable work record before it can transact at scale. Each vertex in the reputation graph earns trust only through completed jobs attested by independent peers, and its horizon of allowed transaction size grows slowly with that record. A newcomer that behaves like a garden weed, many fresh identities with no history, stays capped at tiny amounts, so an attacker must fund, stake, and patiently mature every fake identity, making a Sybil flood far more expensive than the fraud it could earn.
